description: MCPAgent configuration: the MCP server (python mcp/server.py) and the agent that uses it
(python mcp/client.py). Validated against schemas/mcpagent.schema.json; paths are relative to
server: the MCP server, which serves the shared agents/tools folder.
mcp_server_port, mcp_server_bind_address: where it listens; "0.0.0.0" binds to all interfaces.
show_usage_examples: print example curl commands on startup.
tools_dir: the tool manifests (<tool>/tool.json); each tool is named after its folder.
tools_env: environment variables every tool gets, e.g. which agent runs it.
client: the agent: its log level, the shared context files and the MCP servers it uses.
instructions_file, models_file, output_file, agent_file: shared by all three agents;
--profile, --local or --openai picks a model profile, else models_file's "default".
servers: an HTTP server without "config" is the server section's, at its address and port.

server.description: Serves the shared agents/tools folder over MCP.

servers.description: The shared agents/tools folder, served by the server section above.
